checks.label: Unarmed Strike
checks.description: Attack with fists, feet, or natural weapons when no weapon is in hand.

checks.label: Dodge
checks.description: Step out of the way of an incoming attack, trap, or area effect.

checks.label: Shield Block
checks.description: Catch an incoming blow on a raised shield.

checks.label: Deflect Missile
checks.description: Bat aside or slip a thrown or shot missile without armor or shield (needs a perk that allows it).

checks.label: Sneak
checks.description: Move without being seen or heard.

checks.label: Pick Lock
checks.description: Open a lock without its key.

checks.label: Disarm Trap
checks.description: Make a simple mechanical trap safe.

checks.label: Pick Pocket
checks.description: Take something from a person without them noticing.

checks.label: Conceal Object
checks.description: Hide a small object on your person so a search misses it.

checks.label: Persuade
checks.description: Talk someone into a course of action with charm or argument.

checks.label: Barter
checks.description: Haggle a price up or down.

checks.label: Lie
checks.description: Make someone believe something untrue.

checks.label: Intimidate
checks.description: Make someone back down or comply through threat.

checks.label: Read Intent
checks.description: Judge what someone wants or feels from how they act.

checks.label: Recall Lore
checks.description: Remember what is known about a creature, place, faith, or piece of magic.

checks.label: Search
checks.description: Find a hidden object, door, or clue in an area.

checks.label: Deduce
checks.description: Draw a conclusion from the clues at hand.

checks.label: Track
checks.description: Follow a creature's trail.

checks.label: Forage
checks.description: Find food, water, or shelter in the wild.

checks.label: Navigate
checks.description: Keep a heading and find the way without a road.

checks.label: Calm Animal
checks.description: Settle a frightened or hostile beast.

checks.label: Command Animal
checks.description: Make a trained beast or mount do what you ask.

checks.label: Treat Wounds
checks.description: Dress wounds and stop bleeding without magic.

checks.label: Diagnose
checks.description: Name the disease or poison that ails a patient.

checks.label: Tend Crops
checks.description: Bring a crop or herd through a season.

checks.label: Climb
checks.description: Climb a wall, cliff, or rope.

checks.label: Swim
checks.description: Swim against a current or stay afloat.

checks.label: Jump
checks.description: Leap a gap or clear an obstacle.

checks.label: Grapple
checks.description: Seize, hold, or break free of a hold.

checks.label: Mend Gear
checks.description: Repair worn or broken equipment.

checks.label: Brew Potion
checks.description: Brew a potion or poison from reagents.

checks.label: Identify Reagent
checks.description: Learn an ingredient's effects by study or taste.

checks.label: Enchant Item
checks.description: Bind an effect into an item.

checks.label: Build Mechanism
checks.description: Design and assemble a device, lock, or siege engine.

checks.label: Construct Structure
checks.description: Raise a building, wall, or bridge.
